entries.conditions: still present on the 2.2.0 wheel: a rank-3 PAD on a non-innermost axis returns the tensor shifted by one row along the outermost axis (row 0 zeros). Same result at fp16 and enforce_f32. Innermost-axis pads and the rank-4 form are correct (LiteRT #9272 flavor matrix). Reproduced here inside a graph, not only as a single op: the bisect walks straight to the PAD. Upstream answer (LiteRT #9272, 2026-10-01T03:50:16Z, https://github.com/google-ai-edge/LiteRT/issues/9272#issuecomment-5924357456): the row shift "is tied to how MLDrift maps lower-rank tensors into its 4D `BHWC` representation"; "promoting the tensor to rank-4 via `RESHAPE` / `EXPAND_DIMS` (or using `CONCAT`) is the recommended workaround" - the rewrite below. Closed as a duplicate of the tracking issue LiteRT #10445 (opened 2026-10-01: standard shape broadcasting, or automatic 4D RESHAPE insertion for lower- and mixed-rank inputs, in the MLDrift GPU delegate).

entries.conditions: SUM accumulates in fp16 under the default GPU precision, so any reduction whose running total passes 65504 returns Inf, which reaches the graph output as NaN (LiteRT #9249) — squeeze-excite pooling (efficientnet_b0), an attention-side reduction (Matcha) and a LayerNorm variance (Gecko) all trip it. The element count is irrelevant, only the magnitude of the total. With enforce_f32 the same files verify (efficientnet_b0 max abs diff 3.7e-5, Gecko 1.4e-7). AVERAGE_POOL_2D-lowered pooling (efficientnet_b1) does not overflow

rewrite_hints.symptom: whole output NaN on GPU, correct on CPU; bisect stops at the first SUM whose CPU output exceeds 65504
rewrite_hints.rewrite: run with GpuOptions(enforce_f32=True), or lower the reduction as MEAN / AVERAGE_POOL_2D (divides while accumulating) or a hierarchical mean (litert_gpu_toolkit.hierarchical_mean)
rewrite_hints.expected_effect: measured: efficientnet_b0 verifies at enforce_f32 (max abs diff 3.7e-5 vs CPU)

entries.conditions: silently miscomputed at both fp16 and enforce_f32: the single op ADD([4096,256] activation, [4096,256] constant) returns max abs diff 7.4 vs CPU (values ~N(0,2)); the identical add at rank 3 ([1,4096,256]) is bit-exact. Whole-model control: lifting only the three rank-2 constant adds of the SAM 2.1 mask decoder v1 to rank 3 (RESHAPE-ADD-RESHAPE) takes the decoder from max abs diff 18.9 to 1.07e-4 at enforce_f32, the same figure as the rank-4 v2 export. On this backend the v1/v2 difference reported in LiteRT #8619 is these adds, not the attention rank; the Pixel 8a result in that issue is not re-measured here. Upstream answers (2026-10-01): on LiteRT #8619 (https://github.com/google-ai-edge/LiteRT/issues/8619#issuecomment-5924355840, 03:50:06Z) the decoder miscompute is "a known limitation in the MLDrift GPU backend's lower-rank (rank-3) to 4D `BHWC` layout mapping. For now, reshaping/promoting lower-rank attention tensors to rank-4 is the required workaround"; on LiteRT #10231 (https://github.com/google-ai-edge/LiteRT/issues/10231#issuecomment-5924354052, 03:49:56Z) the rank-2 + rank-3 constant ADD is "a known limitation in the MLDrift GPU backend regarding shape broadcasting for mixed/lower-rank tensors (especially when constant tensors are involved, which currently bypass automatic 4D broadcast reshape insertion)"; "inserting an explicit `RESHAPE` or `EXPAND_DIMS` before the `ADD` is the recommended workaround". The #8619 answer names the attention rank, the site measured on this backend is the rank-2 constant add; both are lower-rank inputs in the class of the tracking issue LiteRT #10445 (opened 2026-10-01: standard shape broadcasting, or automatic 4D RESHAPE insertion for lower- and mixed-rank inputs, in the MLDrift GPU delegate), as a duplicate of which both issues were closed.

entries.conditions: both the GPU-only and the GPU|CPU compile fail at kernel creation, at fp16 and enforce_f32 alike: `Failed to create DelegateKernelLiteRtMetal: INVALID_ARGUMENT: Unable to parse bc coord for BATCH axis. Layout is bhwc ... descriptor=float16, TensorStorageType::BUFFER, layout: bhwc, shape: {bhwc, {63, 1, 1, 1024}}` then `Failed to initialize kernel` / `Restored original execution plan`. The refused shape is the rank-2 [63,1024] activation of the attention projections' dynamic-range int8 FULLY_CONNECTED (63 = frames of the 5 s window). Same message as LiteRT #9277, reported on the Mali ML Drift backend for DRQ int8 FULLY_CONNECTED + ADD on rank-3 input — here on Metal 2.2.0. No numerics can be read; the op-level bisect cannot start. Upstream answer (LiteRT #9277, 2026-10-01T03:50:26Z, https://github.com/google-ai-edge/LiteRT/issues/9277#issuecomment-5924359159): the error "is caused by MLDrift's batch broadcast coordinate parser failing when a rank-3 tensor is mapped to 4D `BHWC` during fused kernel codegen. Currently, using rank-2 or explicitly reshaping to a 4D tensor before the operation is the only workaround". Closed as a duplicate of the tracking issue LiteRT #10445 (opened 2026-10-01: standard shape broadcasting, or automatic 4D RESHAPE insertion for lower- and mixed-rank inputs, in the MLDrift GPU delegate). The refused activation here is already rank 2, one of the two workarounds that answer names; the rank-3 rewrite below was inferred from #9277 before the answer, which names rank 3 as the failing mapping.
